summary: The managed-client registration and its assertion now run inside the try/finally boundary, so a pre-existing fixture causes the assertion to fail only after cleanup is guaranteed. The finally block removes the test users and sessions and restores the bootstrap, managed-client, and hub-domain snapshots.

evidence: src/handler_test.ts lines 2216-2231 place createManagedClient and assert(seededRecord) inside the try block, so an already-existing fixture no longer skips cleanup.

The finally block beginning at src/handler_test.ts line 2577 deletes the test sessions and users, restores the bootstrap and pre-existing managed-client and hub-domain records, and removes only audit keys created during the test.
